description: This file contains the PHP class 'CustomField' which manages custom fields in the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods for adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and managing multilingual descriptions and associated data for custom fields in the customer section of OpenCart.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Manages custom fields for customers in the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations and multilingual support.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field record in the database, including descriptions and associated data.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Updates an existing custom field record along with its descriptions and associated data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Removes a custom field and its related descriptions, customer groups, and values from the database.

methods.name: getCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field record, including description for the current language.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Fetches a list of custom fields based on provided filters, such as name, status, location, or customer group.

methods.name: getTotalCustomFields
methods.description: Returns the total count of custom fields matching certain filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description entry for a custom field in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific language across all custom fields.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of a custom field for all available languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all custom field descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associates a custom field with a customer group, optionally marking it as required.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Removes associations between a custom field and all customer groups.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Returns all customer groups associated with a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value option for a custom field, supporting multiple languages.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all value options associated with a custom field.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific custom field value, including descriptions.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Lists all value options for a specific custom field.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Creates a description for a particular custom field value in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for values of a custom field.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for a given language.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches descriptions for all values of a custom field.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all value descriptions for a specified language.
